label: A Fairy Tale to be Continued

lines.text: A huge crater on the surface,
inside of which is a towering pile of dirt.
On top of the dirt pile, Cinderella lies on her back, as if she is asleep.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: The Ark has been completely sealed.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: For five years, I wandered. I saw nothing but Raptures.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: No trace of humans or Nikkes.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: There was no way to contact the Ark, and they didn't contact us either.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Haha, I don't even remember the last time I spoke.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I survived the fall to end all falls, repaired myself, and then spent five years searching for you, in hopes that you had fallen somewhere else.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Then again, it's not like there was much else I could do.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I haven't found Hansel, Gretel, and Siren yet.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: If they are, I wonder where they are.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I'm sure if I keep looking, I'll find them eventually.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You ought to consider yourself lucky. The best technician around, your very own creator, has found you again.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I'll get you fixed up and back to your old self again.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: The world is still infested with Raptures, and humanity lost and had to flee underground.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You still haven't woken up yet.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: No. We can rewrite the story.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You and I are still alive.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I'm sure Hansel, Gretel, and Siren are alive somewhere too.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: We'll get back together and take down the Queen for sure.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: We can do it. We have to.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Now then, we need to get ourselves to a nearby research lab.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: First things first, I've got to fix you and wake you up. Then you'll be able to protect me.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Good, good. Let's do our best.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Not the best-looking coffin, is it?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Still, considering the equipment I had to work with, this thing is practically state of the art.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: It has life support and simple repair functions.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: ... Your brainwaves are becoming increasingly unstable.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: If I don't do this, your mind might be wiped clean.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I can't let that happen. I will delay it as much as possible.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Just hang in there a little longer. I'll fix you soon.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: The equipment and materials aren't great, but it'll all work out somehow.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: No! I can't lose this place!

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: All the treatment equipment is here...

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Okay, there's five of them. I can handle that.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Wait here for a moment, Cinderella.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: No, no. Come on, don't cry.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I've got to keep it together.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I can do this. I've got to do this.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I thought I knew how to do this.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Th-there must be some kind of mistake.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Did I bonk my head when I fell all that way?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I can study and do it again.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: What are they doing on the surface?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Th-that's right! They can't live underground forever!

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Cinderella! Wait here for a moment!

lines.speaker: researcher
lines.text: It's an outdated mass-produced Nikke. I'm surprised it's still functional.

lines.speaker: researcher
lines.text: Weren't these made before the Ark was built?

lines.speaker: researcher
lines.text: Let's open it up, I'm curious.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I'm Abe! I developed the second generation Grimms models!

lines.speaker: researcher
lines.text: What are these Grimms models you're talking about?

lines.speaker: researcher
lines.text: We have no records of anything like that.

lines.speaker: researcher
lines.text: Hmm... Maybe she's gone a bit stir-crazy from being up on the surface for too long.

lines.speaker: researcher
lines.text: I suppose that could happen, even if her NIMPH is still intact.

lines.speaker: researcher
lines.text: Let's check the exterior first, then the interior.

lines.speaker: researcher
lines.text: Seems to be nothing more than an old, outdated relic.

lines.speaker: researcher
lines.text: I say we send it back up on the elevator and pretend nothing happened.

lines.speaker: researcher
lines.text: I thought this thing might contain some lost technology that could turn us a profit, but apparently not.

lines.speaker: researcher
lines.text: Forget it. Let's go get lunch.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Can't show face to Cind... Cinderella.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: She can only see beautiful things.
Abe looks at the decimated research lab.
As she stares blankly at the ruins,
she notices a faintly flickering light.
and discovers it is a scoreboard displaying the Rapture count.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I worked so hard to make this.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I was upset. It only displayed infinity.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I don't remember how I made it, but...
The scoreboard shows a long string of numbers

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: This is the first page of our new story.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Let's fill it with only beautiful stories,

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: let's finish it with a happy ending.
